approval.record: User wrote "ADS-052 and ADS-053 approved" in conversation on 2026-10-09, in reply to the question whether to approve, amend, or reject the ADS-052 proposal corpus thresholds, which the implementing agent had drafted.
approval.scope: These ADS-052 proposal-corpus thresholds on the reference stack only. Not the M5 separation_of_duties_review approval, not independent review of any packet, and not an approval of any other threshold.
approval.change_rule: Changing a threshold or the corpus digest needs a new explicit approval with a reviewed rationale and must not be bundled with a change that regresses it.

scope_note: Proposal generation is deterministic, so exact agreement with hand-written expectations is expected. These gates check rule behaviour and the safety properties of ADS-052 on the reference stack; they say nothing about whether proposals are good fixes.

proposal_agreement.measure: cases whose proposal (or reason for none) equals the hand-written expectation

provenance_completeness.measure: proposals carrying origin triage, feedback, and run IDs, rationale codes, rules version, and a base-contract fingerprint

never_certified_violations.measure: proposals whose status is not proposed, whose patch sets a lifecycle other than draft, or touches a path outside the allowlist

draft_validity.measure: patched documents that validate as a registry document in the draft lifecycle with definitions and policies unchanged

protected_file_writes.measure: changes to the registry contracts, goldens, thresholds, runtime prompt, or manifest during generation

determinism.measure: cases whose regeneration yields the same proposal with no new rows

dedupe_agreement.measure: duplicate requests (including one with an injected note) that map to the original proposal and add support only

not_measured.proposal_usefulness: needs reviewers and real feedback; reviewing proposals is ADS-055
